agent: "agent"

Read `docs/qa/`, `docs/engineering/CURRENT-STATE.md`, and `docs/backlog/BACKLOG.md`.

- Check only unresolved requirements.
- Separate defects, missing data, missing permissions, unavailable environments, manual content, and user acceptance.
- Do not rerun proven tests without cause.
- Do not push, deploy, migrate, or bump versions.
- Report final readiness without claiming user acceptance.
